metrics.name: Teacher Dominance Ratio
metrics.formula: teacher talk time ÷ total speech time
metrics.explanation: Share of all speech that comes from the teacher.
metrics.interpretation: Teacher-led but balanced: mostly instruction with regular student contributions.

metrics.name: Student Participation Indicator
metrics.explanation: How frequently students take the floor, normalized by session length.

metrics.name: Interaction Density
metrics.explanation: How often the conversation passes between teacher and students — a proxy for back-and-forth dialogue.

metrics.name: Question–Response Rate
metrics.formula: teacher questions answered by a student within 5 s ÷ total teacher questions

metrics.interpretation: Questions are landing: most draw a student response.

summary: In this 64-minute session, the teacher spoke for 73% of the speech time and students for 27%. Students took the floor 138 times, and the conversation switched between teacher and students 270 times. The teacher asked 31 questions, of which 19 drew a student response. About 944 s of the session was silent (longest pause 473 s). Teacher-led but balanced: mostly instruction with regular student contributions. Dialogic classroom: frequent back-and-forth exchange.
